title: Coefficient
description: A polished vanilla+ Fabric Modpack focused on high FPS, immersive visuals, smoother gameplay, and PvP Combats
body:
# Coefficient

### A Polished Vanilla Modpack Optimized for Low-End PCs

Coefficient is a modpack focused on improving Minecraft’s performance and delivering smoother gameplay for low-end PC users.

**This pack contains various Visual enhancement mods as well as Mods Essenstial for PvP**

**Coefficient includes my personal in-game settings, keybinds, and optimized configuration files to provide the intended gameplay and visual experience right after installation. Feel free to change any settings, keybinds, or mods based on your own preference.**

_**Some ambient and immersion-focused mods may feel stronger depending on personal preference. For example, if you find the ambient sounds too intense, you can simply lower their volume or disable the mod through the Mods menu or Mod Menu settings.**_

The pack is designed as a complete Minecraft experience, including everything needed for smooth, immersive, and enjoyable gameplay.A showcase video for the pack will be released soon.

## Overview

A polished vanilla+ Fabric modpack focused on massive FPS boosts, immersive visuals, smooth animations, enhanced UI, and quality-of-life improvements — while keeping the original Minecraft experience clean, optimized, and familiar.

Coefficient is designed to modernize Minecraft without destroying the original vanilla feel. Every mod, visual enhancement, animation, and optimization was carefully selected to create a cleaner, faster, and more immersive experience while keeping gameplay familiar and balanced.

Whether you're exploring survival worlds, building aesthetic bases, playing multiplayer with friends, or using shaders, Coefficient delivers a smoother and more refined Minecraft experience from start to finish.

_The mods and resource packs used in this modpack are not created by me. Full credit goes to their original creators, and thank you so much for the amazing work._

---

# Performance First

Coefficient heavily improves Minecraft’s performance using powerful optimization mods including:

* Sodium
* Lithium
* FerriteCore
* ImmediatelyFast
* C2ME
* MoreCulling
* Entity Culling
* ModernFix

These optimizations provide:

* Higher FPS
* Faster chunk loading
* Lower memory usage
* Reduced lag spikes
* Smoother rendering
* Better overall stability

The pack is designed to feel lightweight and responsive even on lower-end systems.

---

# Customization & Settings

The Pack includes a pre-configured `options.txt` and carefully adjusted mod settings to provide the intended visual style, smoother gameplay experience, and optimized performance right after installation.

Most visual and utility mods included in the pack are fully optional. If you do not like a specific feature or mod, you can simply disable it, remove it, or adjust its settings based on your preference.

# Immersive Visuals

Coefficient enhances Minecraft visually while staying true to the vanilla aesthetic.

## Includes

* Dynamic lighting
* Improved particles
* Better weather effects
* Swinging lanterns
* Waving capes
* Enhanced clouds & ambience
* Visual armor trims
* Panorama improvements
* Better GUI animations
* Enhanced inventory visuals

The result is a world that feels more alive, cinematic, and polished without becoming overcomplicated.

---

# Better Animations & Atmosphere

Minecraft feels significantly smoother and more immersive with:

* Fresh player animations
* Enhanced entity animations
* Improved movement visuals
* Better combat feel
* Animated interactions
* Ambient visual upgrades

Small details throughout the game make movement, exploration, and combat feel much more modern and satisfying.

---

# PvP Enhancements

Coefficient also includes multiple utility and PvP-focused improvements that make survival, exploration, and combat feel smoother and more informative without cluttering the screen.

## Included Features

* AppleSkin hunger/saturation preview
* Armor HUD overlays
* Cleaner hotbar & crosshair visuals
* Improved tooltips
* Status effect visibility
* Cleaner inventory interactions
* Better combat readability
* Enhanced GUI feedback
* Modernized item pickup notifications
* Utility-focused HUD improvements

These additions help players manage combat, hunger, armor durability, and inventory information more efficiently while maintaining a clean vanilla-friendly look.


# Quality of Life Improvements

Coefficient includes many carefully chosen quality-of-life features to improve everyday gameplay.

## Features

* Zoom functionality
* Better HUD & GUI
* Armor overlays
* Cleaner tooltips
* Mouse Tweaks support
* Pickup notifications
* Better advancements UI
* Controller support
* Inventory visual effects
* Improved menus and navigation

Everything is designed to feel smoother, cleaner, and less cluttered.

---

# Resource Pack Collection

Coefficient includes a large collection of visual resource packs that improve Minecraft while preserving the vanilla style.

## Includes

* Better skies
* Enhanced enchant visuals
* Cleaner fonts/icons
* Revamped mobs
* Improved ores/tools
* Better particles & fire
* Enhanced containers/UI
* Vanilla-style visual polish

The pack keeps Minecraft recognizable while making the entire game feel significantly more modern and aesthetically pleasing.

---

# Shaders

Coefficient fully supports:

* Iris Shaders
* Sodium rendering
* Vanilla-friendly shader experiences

Perfect for cinematic gameplay and immersive survival worlds.

---

# Designed For

Coefficient is perfect for players who want:

* High FPS
* Smooth gameplay
* Aesthetic visuals
* Vanilla+ progression
* Lightweight modded Minecraft
* Long survival playthroughs
* Multiplayer-friendly performance
* Immersive exploration

---

# The Goal of Coefficient

Create a smoother, cleaner, and more immersive version of Minecraft for low-end PC users

No unnecessary complexity.
No overwhelming gameplay changes.
Just polished, optimized, modern Minecraft.
